item.description:
More reliable image text reading

  • Tall selected images are read in overlapping sections so message text is not squeezed into a tiny thumbnail. Very long images have a bounded local reading limit, shown in check details.
  • QR recognition and text recognition are independent. If one fails, DITT keeps the other result. Manual images remain available for the online check.
  • Manual app checks keep readable Accessibility text and links if their screenshot fails. Selected screen regions use the display’s native scale.
  • Check details distinguish text that was read, no text found and recognition errors. Exports include image dimensions, line counts and diagnostic codes.
  • Missing scores show the server’s explanation when available. This update does not invent scores or change server scoring.

Saved settings, exclusions and history are preserved. No new permission is required.
